changes: Added bounded Mega subscription-list discovery by exact username using the existing backend-only Mega token.

On an unmapped login, the backend now discovers exactly one matching Mega subscription, retrieves that subscription by ID and persists the provider-supplied per-line dns_link before Xtream authentication.
Existing mapped users continue directly through their stored authoritative dns_link without a Mega scan.
The new Extreme client contract remains username/password only and continues to accept only the backend-resolved exact origin.
